source_cards.title: Open-Amp: Synthetic Data Framework for Audio Effect Foundation Models
source_cards.finding: Device-diverse synthetic rendering improved the tested effect representation and supported low-data embedding enrolment, but every selected one-to-one device model outperformed the one-to-many model for its own device and no controlled listening test established preferred tone.
limitations: only three analogue pedals in the low-data enrolment study
one-to-many fidelity below one-to-one on all five selected devices
study settings are not production presets

source_cards.title: GOAT: A Large Dataset of Paired Guitar Audio Recordings and Tablatures
source_cards.finding: Paired DI, symbolic and re-amped data provide a useful evaluation structure; amp-domain augmentation helped the tested amp-domain transcription but did not uniformly outperform DI training across domains or dataset sizes.
limitations: authors do not exclusively own all copyrights
commercial cabinet processing in rendering path
larger augmentation was not uniformly better

implementation_audits.name: GOAT-Dataset repository
findings: render notebook references commercial Neural DSP cabinet processing and local plugin/preset paths
random render choices have no fixed seed
song-name-specific split logic does not cleanly reproduce the anonymised public description

knowledge_cards.claim: Device diversity can improve effect representations without proving preferred guitar tone.
One-to-many conditioning trades device-specific fidelity for coverage in the tested Open-Amp setup.
Open-Amp low-data embedding enrolment is promising but supported here by only three analogue pedals and objective metrics.
A declared test-device list is not evidence of held-out evaluation unless the executed validation path consumes it.
Unpinned dependencies and a basic demo script prevent exact paper-reproduction claims.
Paper, code, capture-model and source-audio rights require independent clearance.
Paired DI-to-processed data supports controlled renderer evaluation only when pair and processing provenance are rights-cleared.
GOAT rights caveats block its use as a reusable project multitrack or Reference Card.
Stochastic re-amping without seeds and a parameter manifest is not reproducible augmentation.
A commercial cabinet path prevents exact free reproduction unless replaced and revalidated.
Amp augmentation gains are domain-specific and do not imply uniform improvement on DI or other datasets.
Sequence accuracy dominated by wait or silence tokens is not a valid proxy for musical correctness.
